title: 第52章 空政：之前是我们声音太大了
content_zh:
第52章 空政：之前是我们声音太大了-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

李春燕将今天最新的《解放军报》递给了刘济民，转头看向王爱梅笑问道：“王姨，你们在屋里干嘛呢？眼圈咋红了！”
“没事儿！”王爱梅笑道，“济民，你可得好好谢谢春燕，春燕现在经常给我们带报纸和杂志，都是关于你的。”
“小事儿。今天有最新消息了，前几天不是有不少人骂卫生员吗？今天啊，军报上刊登了一则新闻，讲的是空军某部指战员集体阅读《壮志凌云》，说各部都踊跃阅读，还有的营区收到了驻地的群众的关怀。空政夸赞《壮志凌云》非但没有破坏空军形象，反而提高了空军形象。”
刘振国凑到报纸旁嘟囔道：“骂的是他们，夸的也是他们！”
“爸，任何事物都有一个发展过程嘛。真理有时候不一定掌握在多数人手中，这也相当于认错了！”
“态度还是不够诚恳！”刘振国调侃道，想让气氛轻松一点。
李春燕夸赞道：“最近《解放军文艺》的读者明显多了起来，我们那儿天天挤一堆人。好了，我回去吃饭了。”
“春燕，留下吃吧！”
“不了，我奶奶已经做好饭了。”李春燕转身，一瘸一拐地朝着对面走去。
“你脚怎么了？”刘济民问道。
“这不是买杂志的人太多，我搬书的时候被人挤了下，砸着脚了！”李春燕无奈地伸出手，说道：“瞧，递来递去，我手都脱皮了。”
“春燕，吃饭了！”
“走了，王姨，你们吃！”
等李春燕走后，刘振国拿起报纸读了起来，文章末尾写道：
“自从真理标准问题提出以来，‘实践是检验真理唯一标准’深入人心。我空军指战员，对于真理标准问题同样进行了深刻的讨论。但在许多人的观念里，依然抱着老一套，不愿意接受新事物。
从《壮志凌云》深受战士和群众喜爱来看，实践证明了《壮志凌云》确实是一部描绘空军生活、战斗的佳作！”
刘振国和王爱梅看完后非常高兴，这份报纸证明了刘济民中断学业并不是被打击报复。
“把咱家的副食品票都给济民，回部队，得给战友带点东西。”刘振国说道。
吃完饭，刘济民骑着自行车到火车站出示证件和调令后，顺利地买到了一张硬卧票。火车从燕京出发，郑州中转后，再到洛阳驻地。
买完火车票后，刘济民拿着家里的副食品票，到王府井买了四斤的大白兔奶糖和一些饼干。回到学校，刘济民又问杨波等人要了不少票。
不过这次回去，也不知道能见到几个老战友。
刘济民买了一大堆东西放在宿舍里，晚上和杨波一起请宿舍几人吃了顿饭。
“说回去就回去，这调令也真是的，济民，回去记得给我们写信，可别忘了我们！”
杨波打断了梁满囤的抱怨，举起酒杯说道：“来吧，济民重归革命大熔炉，我们祝他一帆风顺，建功军营！”
“来！”

Li Chunyan handed today's latest "People's Liberation Army Daily" to Liu Jimin, turned to look at Wang Aimei and asked with a smile: "Aunt Wang, what are you doing in the room? Why are your eye circles so red!"
"It's okay!" Wang Aimei smiled, "Jimin, you have to thank Chunyan properly. Chunyan often brings us newspapers and magazines now, all about you."
"It's a small thing. Today is the latest news. Didn't a lot of people scold the health workers a few days ago? Today, the military newspaper published a news about the commanders and fighters of a certain Air Force unit collectively reading "Top Gun". They said that all units read it enthusiastically, and some camps received care from the people stationed there. The air force officer praised "Top Gun" not only for not damaging the image of the Air Force, but for improving it."
Liu Zhenguo leaned close to the newspaper and muttered: "They are the ones who are scolded, and they are also praised!"
"Dad, everything has a development process. Sometimes the truth may not be in the hands of the majority of people. This is equivalent to admitting a mistake!"
"The attitude is still not sincere enough!" Liu Zhenguo joked, trying to make the atmosphere lighter.
Li Chunyan praised: "Recently, the number of readers of "People's Liberation Army Literature and Art" has obviously increased, and our place is crowded with people every day. Okay, I'm going back to eat."
"Chunyan, stay and eat!"
"No, my grandma has already cooked." Li Chunyan turned around and limped towards the opposite side.
"What's wrong with your feet?" Liu Jimin asked.
"It's not that there are too many people buying magazines. I was squeezed when I was moving the books and I hit my foot!" Li Chunyan stretched out her hand helplessly and said, "Look, the skin on my hands is peeling off as I was passing them around."
"Chunyan, it's time to eat!"
"Let's go, Aunt Wang, you eat!"
After Li Chunyan left, Liu Zhenguo picked up the newspaper and read it. At the end of the article he wrote:
"Since the issue of the standard of truth was raised, 'Practice is the only criterion for testing truth' has been deeply rooted in the hearts of the people. Our Air Force commanders have also had in-depth discussions on the issue of the standard of truth. However, many people still hold on to the old ideas and are unwilling to accept new things.
Judging from the popularity of "Top Gun" by soldiers and the masses, practice has proved that "Top Gun" is indeed a masterpiece depicting the life and combat of the Air Force! "
Liu Zhenguo and Wang Aimei were very happy after reading it. This newspaper proved that Liu Jimin's interruption of his studies was not retaliation.
"Give our family's food stamps to Jimin. When we return to the army, we need to bring something to our comrades." Liu Zhenguo said.
After dinner, Liu Jimin rode his bicycle to the train station and after showing his ID and transfer order, he successfully bought a hard sleeper ticket. The train departs from Yanjing, transfers in Zhengzhou, and then arrives at the station in Luoyang.
After buying the train ticket, Liu Jimin took the food stamps at home and went to Wangfujing to buy four kilograms of White Rabbit toffee and some biscuits. Back at school, Liu Jimin asked Yang Bo and others for a lot of votes.
But this time I go back, I don’t know how many old comrades I will see.
Liu Jimin bought a lot of things and put them in the dormitory. In the evening, he and Yang Bo treated several people in the dormitory to a meal.
"Go back as you said. This transfer order is true. Jimin, remember to write to us when you go back, but don't forget us!"
Yang Bo interrupted Liang Mandun's complaints, raised his glass and said, "Come on, Jimin returns to the melting pot of the revolution. We wish him smooth sailing and success in the military camp!"
"Come!"
